analysis.full_description: A creator shares her experience with the Wavytalk Airflow Styler (Whirlwind Curl), opening with finished bouncy curls before showing a before-and-after demonstration. She explains the cooling air mechanism that sets curls instantly without burning hands or damaging hair, and shows the smooth gliding action compared to traditional flat irons.

analysis.transcript_full_original: My hair does not normally look like this by any means, but I just got this Wavytalk airflow styler, and it has made it so easy to curl my hair, not to mention it minimizes heat damage by 50%. I have always been the type to struggle when curling my hair, so I wanted to do a test strand just to start off, and I was shocked by the fact that I got a perfect curl the first time. Now you can see my hand touching the barrel multiple times while curling my hair because the claim is that this cools down your hair while curling it, so the outside is like a fan that cools down the curl while the inside is like a flat iron that is making the curl. And that's because the cool air also helps set the curl. So normally I'll pin my curls right after I curl them to let them cool like that, but this just cools it all in one. As you can tell, this straightener has like a barrel around it, making it easier to pull and curl while you're styling your hair, because whenever I use a hair straightener, my hair will get like caught and stuck, and it will literally hurt my head while I'm curling, but I had no issues with this at all. You can see how smoothly I just pull the curl out. By the end of it, my hair was not feeling fried, and I was shocked by these curls. I definitely took bigger sections, so that's why I think they looked a little bit more like waves, but I thought it was so pretty. This is definitely my new favorite tool, because I actually just lost my curling iron, and this is better for my hair anyway, so I'm very happy with the results.

This is definitely my new favorite tool, because I actually just lost my curling iron, and this is better for my hair anyway, so I'm very happy with the results.
